description: This file defines a PHP class 'EmployeeLicenseSearchFilterParams' which extends within the HRM system, specifically for filtering employee license search criteria. It manages filter parameters and sorting options related to employee licenses, particularly focusing on the 'license issued date' field.

classes.name: EmployeeLicenseSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class used for encapsulating filter parameters for employee license searches within the HRM system. It includes properties for employee number and sorting settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters, setting a default sort field 'el.licenseIssuedDate'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the filter, as an integer.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the filter criterion.
